hero.headline: Engineering **resilient software**, scaling **paid acquisition**, and modeling **market structure** for measurable outcomes.

about.description: What begins as first-principles curiosity becomes shipped software, audited acquisition funnels, and disciplined trading systems. Engineering enforces *rigor*, markets teach *risk control*, and distribution demands *proof*.
about.full:
Hi, I'm **Mohammed Faiz Alam**—a developer, agency founder, and swing trader based in Mumbai who learns by building real systems and measuring their results in the wild.

On the **engineering** side, I work primarily with *React*, *Next.js*, *TypeScript*, *Node.js*, and *Python (FastAPI)*—shipping interactive simulators, quantitative research tools, and zero-CLS storefronts, backed by systems fundamentals in *C* and *MySQL*.

On the **growth** side, I run **AgencyGrow**, managing full-funnel *Google and Meta Ads* campaigns for clients in the UK and beyond—focused on high-intent search capture, clean GA4 event attribution, and disciplined cost-per-lead optimization.

In **financial markets**, I study swing structure through *Volume Profile* (POC, VAH, VAL, HVN/LVN), liquidity sweeps, and risk-penalized reinforcement learning environments.

I'm currently pursuing my **B.Tech in Computer Engineering at Shree L.R. Tiwari College of Engineering**, continuing to ship software, grow client revenue, and refine quantitative models.

projects.title: BB84 Quantum
projects.impact: Real-time QBER eavesdropper detection & One-Time Pad encryption
projects.challenge: Quantum cryptography concepts like basis mismatch and eavesdropper disturbance are notoriously abstract in textbooks, making protocol mechanics difficult to verify intuitively.
projects.architecture: Engineered a React + TypeScript interactive visual pipeline connected to a Python FastAPI quantum state engine that simulates photon preparation, basis sifting, Eve interception, and real-time QBER threshold detection.
projects.outcome: Delivered a step-by-step live simulator that flags channel compromise instantaneously and demonstrates end-to-end One-Time Pad message encryption.
projects.description:
An interactive **BB84 Quantum Key Distribution** simulator showing how quantum physics secures key exchange and catches eavesdroppers. Users step through state preparation, basis selection, key sifting, and *One-Time Pad* encryption in real time.

Built with a *React* and *TypeScript* frontend and a *Python FastAPI* engine, it calculates **Quantum Bit Error Rate (QBER)** to flag interception attempts the moment a third party measures the channel.

projects.title: Nuvora
projects.impact: Zero-CLS editorial storefront built to convert cold traffic into booked calls
projects.challenge: Most creative agencies lose cold paid traffic to generic templates that fail to signal authority or guide prospects smoothly toward booking a discovery call.
projects.architecture: Built with Next.js, React, and TypeScript, combining editorial typography with GPU-accelerated Framer Motion and GSAP choreography while preserving fast first paint and zero layout shift.
projects.outcome: Launched a high-trust digital storefront aligning brand authority directly with AgencyGrow's paid acquisition funnels.
projects.description:
Nuvora is the digital storefront and client acquisition platform for my creative and advertising startup. Designed to turn cold traffic into booked discovery calls, it pairs bold editorial typography with interactive case-study storytelling and clear service positioning.

Engineered with *Next.js*, *React*, and *TypeScript*, the interface uses *Framer Motion*, *GSAP*, and *Locomotive Scroll* for fluid scroll choreography while keeping layout shifts zero and page loads fast across devices.

projects.title: RL Trading Env
projects.impact: Risk-penalized PPO agent workbench with live equity & drawdown blotter
projects.challenge: Naive reinforcement learning trading models overfit raw returns while taking reckless leverage and unrecoverable drawdowns.
projects.architecture: Built a custom Gymnasium environment with a drawdown-penalized reward function, streaming Python FastAPI PPO training telemetry into a React + TypeScript cockpit displaying OHLCV candles, equity curves, and trade blotters.
projects.outcome: Created a repeatable quantitative research workbench to evaluate agent stability, sizing discipline, and risk-adjusted performance across market regimes.
projects.description:
RL Trading Env is a full reinforcement learning workbench for training and evaluating autonomous trading agents against historical and synthetic *OHLCV* market data. Instead of optimizing for raw return alone, its custom *Gymnasium* environment scores agents with a risk-aware reward function that penalizes deep drawdowns and erratic sizing.

The *Python* and *FastAPI* backend runs **Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO)** episodes and streams execution logs to a *React* and *TypeScript* dashboard featuring live price charts, equity curves, drawdown metrics, and trade-by-trade blotters.

projects.title: UK Roofing Ads
projects.impact: High-intent UK Google Search campaigns engineered for lower CPL
projects.challenge: Local home-service search auctions in the UK suffer from wasted spend on broad informational queries and weak lead attribution.
projects.architecture: Structured tight intent-segmented Google Ads ad groups with strict negative keyword hygiene, hyper-local geo-fencing, and verified conversion tracking across calls and forms.
projects.outcome: Improved lead quality and budget efficiency through ongoing search-term pruning, bid adjustments, and transparent CPL reporting.
projects.description:
Managed Google Ads campaigns for a **UK-based roofing business**, focused on turning search intent into qualified enquiries. Campaigns were structured around high-intent roofing keywords, location targeting, and carefully managed budgets to reach customers actively looking for roofing services.

Performance was monitored through **conversion tracking, cost per lead (CPL), click-through rate (CTR), conversion rate, and total ad spend**. Continuous keyword refinement, search term analysis, and bid optimisation helped improve campaign efficiency and make every advertising pound count.

projects.title: Audience Analytics
projects.impact: 89K active users & 1.3M behavioral events audited over 28 days
projects.challenge: High-volume web properties often collect raw traffic numbers without understanding which acquisition cohorts and pages actually drive sustained interaction.
projects.architecture: Audited GA4 event pipelines across 89K active users (80K new users) and 1.3M interactions, isolating landing-page retention, bounce anomalies, and channel distribution.
projects.outcome: Surfaced actionable conversion bottlenecks and high-leverage pages to guide content and acquisition spend allocation.
projects.description:
Analysed website traffic and audience behaviour over a 28-day period, recording **89K active users** and **80K new users**. The property generated **1.3M events**, providing a broader view of how visitors interacted with the website.

Tracked key performance indicators including page views, active users, and bounce rates to understand traffic distribution, identify high-performing pages, and evaluate overall audience engagement.

projects.title: User Engagement
projects.impact: 6m 44s average engagement time across 32K active users
projects.challenge: Traffic spikes mean little if visitors drop off within seconds; distinguishing deep product engagement from hollow clicks requires cohort-level telemetry.
projects.architecture: Monitored daily retention curves, real-time behavioral flows, and geographic concentration across 32K active users and 15K new users over a 28-day window.
projects.outcome: Validated strong product-audience stickiness at 6m 44s average active engagement, identifying top-performing regions for targeted expansion.
projects.description:
Evaluated audience activity across a 28-day period, recording **32K active users** and **15K new users**, with an average engagement time of **6 minutes 44 seconds** per active user.

Monitored daily traffic trends, geographic distribution, and real-time activity to understand how users interacted with the platform. These insights helped build a clearer picture of audience behaviour, acquisition patterns, and engagement quality.
